name: perubahan_dana_psak109
query:
WITH
f AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT G1.JVC_ID
  FROM (
    SELECT jv.id             AS jvc_id,
           g.tanggal::date   AS d,
           jv.cost_code_id   AS cost_code_id,
           g.department_id   AS department_id,
           g.project_id      AS project_id,
           jv.account_id     AS account_id
    FROM g_jurnal g
    JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
  ) G1
  JOIN cost_codes CC1 ON CC1.id = G1.cost_code_id
  LEFT JOIN dept   D1 ON D1.id  = G1.department_id
  LEFT JOIN job    J1 ON J1.project_id = G1.project_id
  JOIN kiraan      K1 ON K1.id  = G1.account_id
  WHERE 1=1 {andWhere}
),
hasil AS (
  SELECT
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cc.code)       AS dana_urut,
    cc.name                                    AS dana_nama,   -- nama dana = nama cost code
    k.code       AS akun_kode,
    k.nama  AS akun_nama,
    SUM(jv.kredit)::numeric(18,2)              AS penerimaan,
    SUM(jv.debit)::numeric(18,2)               AS penyaluran,
    SUM(jv.kredit - jv.debit)::numeric(18,2)   AS mutasi_bersih
  FROM f
  JOIN jurnalvc  jv ON jv.id = f.jvc_id
  JOIN cost_codes cc ON cc.id = jv.cost_code_id
  JOIN kiraan     k  ON k.id  = jv.account_id
  GROUP BY cc.code, cc.name, k.code, k.nama
)
SELECT * FROM hasil
ORDER BY dana_urut, akun_kode {andOrder} {limit}
